name: DEMO 1 — Legitimate Personal Message
message: Hey, are we still meeting for lunch today?
purpose: Demonstrates routine, safe personal conversation with zero suspicious indicators, resulting in a low risk score and suppressed security alerts.

name: DEMO 2 — Urgent Banking Phishing Attack
message: URGENT! Your bank account has been suspended. Verify your account immediately by clicking http://bit.ly/example
purpose: Demonstrates severe smishing combining artificial urgency, fear of account suspension, credential verification, and an obfuscated bit.ly link, triggering critical risk and an immediate security alert.

name: DEMO 3 — Package Delivery Customs Scam
message: FedEx: Your package is waiting. Pay the customs fee immediately at http://bit.ly/example
purpose: Demonstrates how the hybrid heuristic engine flags brand impersonation and shortened URLs, escalating borderline ML predictions to phishing.

name: DEMO 4 — Prize & Cash Reward Lure
message: Congratulations! You have won a cash reward. Claim your prize now at http://bit.ly/example
purpose: Demonstrates lottery and prize baiting targeting user curiosity/greed paired with an obfuscated URL shortener.

name: DEMO 5 — Safe Project Meeting SMS
message: Don't forget our project meeting at 4 PM tomorrow.
purpose: Demonstrates routine institutional scheduling communication without deceptive triggers, confirming low risk and no false alarms.
